author: Tyexpos
quote:
I made an entire account and doing something I thought I'd never do outside of trolling. I made a Reviewer account UNIRONICALLY. 

Grand Theft Auto Six. Is a disappointment. 
From its story, to its characters, to its gameplay and what came before it showed they had no excuse, plus the 2+ billion dollars they spent on it cemented that they had no excuse. 

The game play is alright and the Replayablility maybe gets better if you completely progress throughout the entire game. 
And maybe it will get better with multiplayer. 

But you shouldn't have to play through most or even half the game for it to get good. That courtesy is given to first time devs and the price reflects its unpolished state. That's the sole exception.

The playability should be good from the get go especially from this one. 

You shouldn't have to wait months for them to implement a feature that maybe let's you enjoy your purchase and get actual fun outta it.

Grand Theft Auto Six does not get that. 
100$, 13 year wait, Decades of experience and know how, 2+ billion dollars put into this. 

I will not be going back for another session.
